candidates.change_summary: Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log.
Log the accumulated balance instead of the deposited amount msg.value.
Change the logged data string from "Put" to "Collect".
Always set unlockTime to _unlockTime, dropping the block.timestamp fallback.
Overwrite the balance with msg.value instead of adding to it.
Credit the account with 1 wei less than the deposited amount.
Log with the zero address instead of msg.sender.
Cap unlockTime at block.timestamp so a future unlock time can never be set.
Remove the unlock-time check from the withdrawal guard so funds can be collected even before the unlock time.
Change the balance update from subtraction to addition so the caller's recorded balance increases instead of decreasing after collection.
Delete the else-revert branch so a failed transfer no longer reverts and the balance is silently deducted without payout.
Log the entire remaining balance instead of the withdrawn amount, changing the observable log value.
